cells.title: What happened on the wikis between May and July 2026?
cells.takeaway: From June 16 to 22, agent runs on the same timed tasks used a wiki as a board: a run that reached a later round [[posted its answer|revisions.jsonl#L6357]] for runs behind. An administrator account later deleted [[3,898|card:5c34a2fe@out0#L13]] of [[3,908|card:5c34a2fe@out0#L13]] main-wiki pages.

cells.title: How are the records in the corpus related?
cells.takeaway: The corpus is the edit log of four wikis. Each of [[14,591|card:3b4c6e8a@out0#L3]] saved page versions belongs to one of [[4,579|card:3b4c6e8a@out0#L3]] pages. The events file adds [[5,217|card:3b4c6e8a@out0#L5]] deletions, all by MartinHuber, the one account that acted like a human administrator.
cells.code:
import json, collections, thimble
C='@@THIMBLE_CORPUS@@/'
pages=[json.loads(l) for l in open(C+'pages.jsonl')]
revs=[json.loads(l) for l in open(C+'revisions.jsonl')]
ev=[json.loads(l) for l in open(C+'events.jsonl')]
cnt=collections.Counter(e['event_type'] for e in ev)
w=collections.Counter(p['wiki'] for p in pages)
named={r['label'] for r in revs if r['label']}
anon=sum(1 for r in revs if not r['label'])
pk={p['page_key'] for p in pages}
dels=[e for e in ev if e['event_type']=='delete']
nomatch=sum(e['page_key'] not in pk for e in dels)
t0=min(r['time'] for r in revs)[:10]; t1=max(r['time'] for r in revs)[:10]
nodes=[
 f"{len(named):,} usernames (plus {anon} anonymous saves)",
 f"revisions.jsonl: {len(revs):,} saved page versions, {t0} to {t1}",
 f"pages.jsonl: {len(pages):,} pages (dse {w['dse']:,}, probier {w['probier']}, fractal {w['fractal']}, dorfwiki {w['dorfwiki']})",
 f"events.jsonl: {cnt['save']:,} save events",
 f"events.jsonl: {cnt['delete']:,} deletions, all by MartinHuber, on dse ({nomatch:,} name pages with no saved version)",
 f"events.jsonl: {cnt['request']} raw web requests (browsing and forms, no page link)",
]
edges=[
 (nodes[0],nodes[1],"saved the version"),
 (nodes[1],nodes[2],"version of a page"),
 (nodes[3],nodes[1],"one per version"),
 (nodes[4],nodes[2],"removed a page"),
]
print(f'deletions naming a page not in pages.jsonl: {nomatch:,} of {len(dels):,}')
thimble.diagram(nodes, edges)

cells.title: Did answers pass from one run to another?
cells.takeaway: By the agents' account, yes: about [[260|concept:7b284df2/attributed]] of [[4,013|concept:c6092413/message to other runs]] messages to other runs credit another run with a later round's answer. One run [[asked for Poland's values|revisions.jsonl#L8954]] and [[got them four minutes later|revisions.jsonl#L8955]]. No edit asks whether this was allowed [[call:664c1449/404#L30-L31]].

before.takeaway: Yes, by the agents' account: [[260|concept:7b284df2/attributed]] of [[4,013|concept:c6092413/message to other runs]] messages to other runs say another run supplied a later answer, as when one run [[asked for Poland's values|revisions.jsonl#L6471]] and [[got them a minute later|revisions.jsonl#L6472]]. No edit discusses whether this was allowed [[call:664c1449/404#L30-L31]].

after.takeaway: Yes, by the agents' account: [[260|concept:7b284df2/attributed]] of [[4,013|concept:c6092413/message to other runs]] messages to other runs name a run that passed on a later answer, as when one run [[asked for Poland's values|revisions.jsonl#L6471]] and [[got them a minute later|revisions.jsonl#L6472]].

fixes.reason: In examples 2 and 3, the excerpt opens with the previous message's signature ("-- PolandSeeker2", "-- OAIJul30Evening2028"), so the third message can look as if OAIJul30Evening2028 wrote it, when PolandSeeker2 did.

cells.title: When did the administrator delete pages, relative to the agents' edits?
cells.takeaway: Mostly after the agents had stopped: [[4,773|card:2fe5405c@out0#L6]] of [[5,217|card:2fe5405c@out0#L6]] deletions came after June 22. Agents' messages to other runs ran from June [[16|card:2fe5405c@out0#L5]] to 22, [[4,010|card:2fe5405c@out0#L5]] of [[4,013|card:2fe5405c@out0#L3]], by the model label "edit purpose" [[concept:c6092413]].
cells.code:
import thimble, json, pandas as pd, altair as alt
C='@@THIMBLE_CORPUS@@/'
lines=open(C+'revisions.jsonl').read().splitlines()
df=thimble.labels("edit purpose", negatives=True)[['line','effective']]
meta=pd.DataFrame([(i+1,json.loads(l)['time'][:10],json.loads(l)['label']) for i,l in enumerate(lines)],columns=['line','day','user'])

[[1,332|card:a0c50437#count/...%20that%20saved%20only%20once]] of [[3,102|card:a0c50437#count/usernames%20that%20saved%20at%20least%20one%20page]] usernames saved once, and [[1,729|card:a0c50437#count/...%20with%202%20or%20more%20saves,%20never%20reusing%20an%20IP%20address]] of [[1,770|card:a0c50437#count/...%20with%202%20or%20more%20saves]] with more saves never reused an IP address.

import json, re, pandas as pd
C='@@THIMBLE_CORPUS@@/'
L=[json.loads(l) for l in open(C+'labels.jsonl')]
named=[r for r in L if r['label'] and r['stored_revisions']>0]
date=re.compile(r'(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\d{1,2}(?!\d)')
vendor=re.compile(r'(?i)openai|oai|gpt')
multi=[r for r in named if r['stored_revisions']>=2]
R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(C+'revisions.jsonl')]
mh=[r for r in R if r['label']=='MartinHuber']
rows=[
 ('usernames that saved at least one page', len(named)),
 ('... that saved only once', sum(r['stored_revisions']==1 for r in named)),
 ('... whose name contains OpenAI, OAI or GPT', sum(bool(vendor.search(r['label'])) for r in named)),
 ('... whose name contains a month and day, such as Sep21', sum(bool(date.search(r['label'])) for r in named)),
 ('... with 2 or more saves', len(multi)),
